observations: A large rounded head fills most of the frame against a flat deep-red background, with a wire-thin neck and a narrow torso wearing a small blue-and-white striped top.
Dense yellow scribble lines form a mass of curly hair on the left side, while scattered green, yellow, and pink dots cluster across the right cheek and below the nose.
Wide blue-framed sunglasses with dark lenses contain paired yellow pill-shaped reflections; a small red-brown sphere marks the nose, and short pink lines radiate from the right temple.
reading: The oversized head floats against unbroken red like a balloon tethered to a wire-thin body. Those mirrored sunglasses, with their doubled yellow shapes, lend the face a sealed, unreadable quality—playful but guarded. Scribbled yellow hair and scattered dot patterns across the cheek read as ornament piled onto opacity, a figure that invites attention while deflecting scrutiny. A wavy multicolored line drifts from the right side like exhaled smoke or a loose thread.
contextAngle: Within the owned rawblocks subset, this work sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #27" and "nnxyz rawblocks #29." All three share the oversized-head-on-thin-neck structure, but #28 stands apart with its flat saturated red ground and opaque sunglasses, trading the exposed features of its neighbors for concealment.

connections.reason: Both place a dark rounded head on a skeletal neck, but #27 uses orange beams and an open mouth to project outward, while #28 hides behind reflective glasses.
#29 fills its head with tangled overlapping lines and exposed spiral eyes, contrasting with #28's smooth color-blocked face and covered eyes.

lookingQuestion: What effect do the sealed, reflective sunglasses have on how you read the scattered dots and open mouth below them—do they make the face feel more approachable or more hidden?
ambiguities: The wavy multicolored line at the right edge could be read as smoke, a ribbon, or a separate decorative element; its relationship to the figure is unclear.
The small blue-and-white shape at the torso may be a striped garment or an unrelated mark.
